name: ticket-to-text-engine
description: v0 game engine for Ticket to Text (portable to Swift iMessage extension)

scripts.ios:build: xcodebuild -project TicketToText.xcodeproj -scheme TicketToText -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:run: open -a Simulator && xcrun simctl install booted build/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/TicketToText.app && xcrun simctl launch booted com.apple.MobileSMS
scripts.ios:enginecheck: mkdir -p build && swiftc -O ios/MessagesExtension/Engine/Types.swift ios/MessagesExtension/Engine/Map.swift ios/MessagesExtension/Engine/RNG.swift ios/MessagesExtension/Engine/Game.swift ios/MessagesExtension/Engine/Scoring.swift ios/Tools/enginecheck/main.swift -o build/ttt-enginecheck && build/ttt-enginecheck
